title: share product SEED-Share-Prod list row: present-but-zero share capital 0.00
_note: share-product seam, ZERO-MONEY ROW. request.share_capital "0.00" is shares-products-list-raw.json pageItems[2].shareCapital for product id 1 (SEED-Share-Prod), the exact decimal text the oracle stored: the seed product carries a PRESENT but zero share capital. expect.share_capital_minor "0" is its minor-unit form. request.unit_price "100.00" (pageItems[2].unitPrice) and expect.unit_price_minor "10000". request.total_shares 1000 is pageItems[2].totalShares. A port that serialises a money cell only when it is non-zero DROPS the present-but-zero 0.00 read-back, so it returns an empty share-capital cell and goes red here (and trips the share_capital_minor non-negative invariant).

provenance.note: transcribed from .softhouse/capture/shares/out/shares-products-list-raw.json (product id 1, pageItems[2]): unitPrice 100.00, shareCapital 0.00 (present-but-zero), totalShares 1000.
